notes: Neither API breaks out an image-specific token count in the returned usage object. normalizedFields: imageOutputTokens (<- output_tokens_details.image_tokens or output_tokens when no breakdown is present)
generatedImageCount (from len(data[]), not from the usage object)
notes: gpt-image-1, gpt-image-1.5, and gpt-image-2 are billed by token (text input, image input, and image output tokens all priced per 1M tokens per the pricing reference). dall-e-2 and dall-e-3 are legacy models billed per-image at a fixed price per size/quality and return NO usage object at all -- generatedImageCount there must be inferred from the response's data[] array length, not a usage field.

rawFields: gpt-4o-transcribe / gpt-4o-mini-transcribe: usage.type='tokens', usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens, usage.total_tokens, usage.input_token_details.{audio_tokens,text_tokens}
normalizedFields: audioInputTokens or audioInputSeconds, depending on model
notes: Two different billing units on the same endpoint (POST /audio/transcriptions), distinguished by the usage.type discriminator: 'tokens' for the GPT-4o-based transcription models, 'duration' for whisper-1. A normalizer must branch on usage.type rather than assuming one shape.

rawFields: No usage object is returned in the synchronous POST /audio/speech response body (it returns raw audio bytes, or an SSE stream of audio chunks, not JSON).
notes: tts-1 and tts-1-hd are billed per 1,000,000 input characters. gpt-4o-mini-tts is billed per-token (text input tokens + generated audio output tokens), consistent with its Chat-Completions-style pricing. In both cases, none of this is visible in the synchronous API response -- it is only recoverable after the fact from the organization-level Usage API (GET /v1/organization/usage/audio_speeches), which is a separate authenticated admin endpoint, not part of the request/response cycle.

Realtime API: usage arrives in the response.done server event once the turn's Response is complete; there is no incremental usage in earlier events for that response.

There are scattered SDK-version bug reports of usageMetadata arriving null on the final chunk for certain models/SDK combinations (e.g. a Go SDK GenerateContentStream report for a Gemini 2.5 Pro preview) -- treat a missing final usageMetadata as the INDETERMINATE_FAILURE case in Section 11, not as zero usage.

normalizedFields: totalTokens (<- totalTokenCount; equals promptTokenCount + candidatesTokenCount + toolUsePromptTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount per Google's documented formula)
notes: promptTokensDetails / candidatesTokensDetails / cacheTokensDetails are arrays of {modality, tokenCount} pairs (modality one of TEXT, IMAGE, AUDIO, VIDEO, DOCUMENT), giving the modality-level breakdown within the same token unit -- Gemini does not use a separate billing unit per modality for text/image/video/audio understanding, everything is 'provider tokens', just tagged by modality.

normalizedFields: imageInputTokens (<- sum of promptTokensDetails entries where modality='IMAGE')
notes: Image input tokens are counted into promptTokenCount (aggregate) AND broken out separately by modality in promptTokensDetails -- both aggregate and modality-specific usage are present simultaneously, unlike OpenAI and Anthropic which report image tokens folded into the aggregate only.

rawFields: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image / Gemini 3 Pro Image: candidatesTokensDetails[] entry with modality='IMAGE', counted into candidatesTokenCount
